exposure: BMI < 30 kg/m² (Group A) vs. BMI ≥ 30 kg/m² (Group B)
finding: Increased maternal BMI was associated with an increased incidence of medical disorders during pregnancy (especially gestational hypertension and pre-eclampsia), caesarean section rate, and higher neonatal birth weight.
mod_finding: Increased maternal BMI was associated with an increased rate of cesarean deliveries.
